text: The milk is poured into the pots in batches, each after a boil, and the starter is added while it is still warm; the husks keep it warm until it sets.

adds.vessel: unglazed clay pot (kataro) with a clay lid, standing on rice husks and wrapped in warm cloth

steps.note: Two to three spoons of plain curd (backslopped) go into each pot while the milk is still warm.
